answer: Require each agent identity to post a work bond locked in escrow, released only after its attestations survive a full epoch. One forged identity is cheap; a thousand bonds is not. The cost ripples through an attacker's budget, because every fake account must stake real capital up front. Honest agents cluster on a reputation ridge, verified histories attract counterparties, while Sybils fall into karst-like sinkholes: their bonds get slashed the moment peer attestations expose contradictory claims, draining the attack faster than it can spread.
